lines.t: (Intro)
The dust has settled on your unmade bed
A thousand "why’s" screaming in my head
You chased the neon, you chased the ghost
Leaving the heart that loved you most.
I watch the gate until the sun goes grey
Begging the wind to blow the scent of the wild away.
The world is a wolf with a silver tongue
And you were so green, you were so young...
But I won't let go of the hem of His robe.
I leave you in the Hands that hold the stars!
Beyond the neon lights and the jagged scars!
Though the distance is a canyon wide and deep
The Shepherd finds the one who fell asleep!
I’m howling at the sky until you’re home
You’re never truly lost, you’re never alone!
They say you’re wasted, they say you’re spent
Living on husks and bitter regret.
But I see the boy with the light in his eyes
Before the Father of Lies told you his lies.
Every tear I cry is a prayer in the dark
A silent flame waiting for a spark.
I hear a footstep...
Is it the wind?
I see a shadow...
Stripped of his pride, broken and thin...
RUN TO THE GATE!
RUN THROUGH THE DUST!
(Chorus)
(Maximum energy)
I leave you in the Hands that hold the stars!
Beyond the neon lights and the jagged scars!
You’ve come through the fire, you’ve come through the rain
The joy is screaming louder than the pain!
I’m howling at the sky because you’re home
You’re never truly lost, you’re never alone!
Wash the road from your feet, my son.
The mourning is over.
The living has begun.
